resources.string: This host applies the saved proxy when the session starts, so a changed address or password applies the next time Natune launches. The proxy covers catalog, YouTube, Last.fm and upload requests. Playback audio, now-playing artwork, Listen Together, listener presence and Japanese pack downloads keep the system route. IP rotation is unavailable here. Localhost, loopback addresses and *.local hosts bypass the proxy. An HTTP proxy password is answered only when the proxy asks for it. A SOCKS proxy password is best effort on this host.
